meta.notes: The tutorial's third mission: a walled fuel halt on a road at night. He goes in alone with his own kit (gate, truck court, arch, gun court, shop, store), then calls his four up and has them use theirs (the breaker box, the bunk room, the fuel room, the wash yard). Its fights are staged by levels/tut-kit.script.ts. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts tut-kit

steps.line: Leave your squad at the truck and go in to the wooden door
Press [Space] to open the door
Go through and move up beside the blue gate
Press [C] to crouch, then follow the sandbags
Press [3], then click the ring to throw smoke there
Cross behind the smoke
Press [5], then click the ring to throw a frag at the gun
Press [1] to switch to your pistol, because it's much quieter
Shoot out the light with your pistol so you can hide in the dark
Hold [Space] on the door to see what you can do

explain.title: Using things
explain.text:
Press [Space] to use what's in front of you, like the door you just opened. This door is locked, so a tap won't open it.
Hold [Space] and a ring will come up with everything you can do there.

steps.line: Press [Tab] to close it, like any menu
Hold [Space] on the door again and pick the charge
Stand clear with your back to the wall beside the door
Press [F] to blow the door
Lean in and shoot the guard inside
Press [4], then click the ring to throw a stun grenade, and get behind the wall

explain.title: Throwing a stun grenade
explain.text: A stun grenade blinds anyone nearby who can see it go off, and that includes you. Walls and closed doors block the flash, but an open doorway doesn't. Throw it through the doorway, then move to the side so you're behind the wall when it goes off.

steps.line: Go in and shoot them both
Press [2] to switch back to your rifle
Go back to the blue gate

explain.title: Using the rifle's launcher
explain.text: Your rifle has a grenade launcher under the barrel. You can see how many grenades you've got next to your ammo at the bottom left. Hold the right mouse button to aim and let go to fire. A grenade won't go off if it lands too close to you.

steps.line: Turn around and watch the shop doorway for two more enemies
Hold the right mouse button, aim at the doorway, and let go
Shoot the rest
Press [B] on yourself to call your squad up
Press [B] on the breaker box to cut the lights

after.line: A buddy team is going for the breaker box

explain.title: Light
explain.text:
Enemies can only fight what they can see. In the dark they'll slow down and turn on flashlights.
Your squad has night vision, so cut the lights and you'll own the dark.

steps.line: Press [N] to turn on night vision
[X] on the bunk room door

after.line: They're stacking up with a stun grenade ready
after.word: They're going in behind the stun grenade

explain.title: The squad's ring
explain.text:
A tap of [B] gives your squad the usual order for whatever you're pointing at.
[X] and a ring will come up with everything else they can do there. On a door, they can throw a stun grenade in first.

steps.line: [X] on the wall
steps.flatLine: Press [5] for more, then pick the wall charge with [3]
steps.menuLine: Press [5] for more, then pick the wall charge with [3]

after.line: They're putting the charge on the wall

explain.title: Walls
explain.text:
The next room's door is locked, and the enemy inside is watching it anyway.
A charge on the wall will get your squad in where nobody's waiting.

steps.line: Press [F] to blow it
Press [B] on yourself, then lead your squad back out to the court
Two more are hiding in the yard, and you can see their flashlights
[X] on the ground behind the sandbags
steps.flatLine: Press [5] for more, then pick the frag with [1]
steps.menuLine: Press [5] for more, then pick the frag with [1]

after.line: A teammate is throwing a frag over the sandbags

steps.line: Finish off anyone who's left
